name: Rue des Gestes — étape 15 · coincer, étaler, caler
note: Tiered verb place; all six verbs are -er, so they all live on the LEFT cottages (the right side is a low stone wall with hedges, no verbs). Tiers: street (man stuck in his doorway with a giant gold coin, tall baker spreading butter on a huge loaf slice, woman wrapping a present), balcony (goose jostling a man aside), upper (kittens piled up on a tasselled cushion beside an oval mirror), roof (man wedging a book under a wobbly table leg). Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles.

items.mirror: oval mirror on the wall beside the window
